notes: Pivoted from selling infrastructure to recruiting enterprise Design Partners / CAB members via ego and expert critique.

A1_design_partner_critique.label: design_partner_critique
A1_design_partner_critique.description: Ask enterprise engineering/security leaders to poke holes in our MCP Guard / Receipt architecture.
A1_design_partner_critique.hypothesis: Leaders ignore pitches but love giving expert opinions and tearing down new architecture.

O1_nist_framework.label: nist_framework
O1_nist_framework.description: Lead with the NIST submission credibility and ask for a critique.

rules.tone: architect_to_peer — technical, humble, seeking harsh feedback, zero corporate speak
never: Don't ask to 'explore synergies' or 'jump on a quick call'.
Don't send links in the connection note.
Don't use salesy language like 'we help companies like yours'.
always: Lead with credibility (NIST submission, MCP Guard open-source).
Ask them to tell us why our approach WON'T work in their enterprise environment.
Offer the 60s NemoClaw demo video as a low-friction visual.
Give them a completely pressure-free out in the follow-up.
